args.body: Pause discretionary tender inventory, preview features and conversion polish following TENDER-PAID-VALUE-EVIDENCE. Preserve the live approved release and all existing expiry obligations. Reconsider paid tender development only on a concrete buyer request for a distinct deliverable or new evidence of willingness to pay; missing feedback is not rejection. No duplicate release or notification is needed.

description: The latest comparison found that our free tender preview duplicates the proposed CAD49 deliverable, so further tender development lacks a supported paid distinction. Feedback remains uncertain: five sources are unclassified, and no revenue or spendable funds are verified. Preserve live experiments and expiry duties while testing a separate paid editorial channel; existing marketplace and payment dependencies do not establish a global blockage.
